DEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT(this“Amendment")is made thisne day of March, 2023 by and between 260 FIFTH AVENUE LLC ("Owner"), a New York limited liability company, having an address at 4501 Spring Valley Road, Dallas, TX 75244, and FIVE POINTS 262 PROJECT LLC ("Developer"), a Delaware limited liability company, having an address at 260 Fifth Avenue, New York,New York 10001. STATEMENTOFFACTS Owner is the owner in fee of certain land, with the building and improvements thereon,in the County of NewYork,City and State of NewYork,generallyknown by the street address 260FifthAvenue,NewYork,NewYork,designated asLot 42inBlock 830 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of New York (the “Tax Map") and more particularly described on Exhibit A annexed hereto (the“Owner Premises"). Developer is the owner in fee of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon or to be constructed thereon, in the County of New York, City and State of New York, generally known by the street address 262 Fifth Avenue, New York, New York, designated as Lot 44 (f/k/a 44, 144,45) in Block 830 on the Tax Map and more particularly described on·Exhibit B annexed hereto (the “Developer Premises"). Owner and Developer previously entered into that certain Second Amended and Restated Zoning Lot Development and Easement Agreement dated as of May 7,2021 and recorded in the Office of the City Register of the City of NewYork on May 26,2021 as CRFN 2021000195143(the“ZLDA"). Owner and Developer wish to amend the ZLDA in the manner set forth below. NOW THEREFORE,in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements contained in this Amendment and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby conclusively acknowledged, Owner and Developer covenant and agreeasfollows: 1. Capitalized Terms. Capitalized terms used in this Amendment, but not defined herein, shall have the same meanings herein as given to them in the ZLDA. 2.Cantilever Easement.
